summary: Unitil Corp. filed an 8-K reporting that its subsidiary, Fitchburg Gas and Electric Light Company, entered into a Note Purchase Agreement on April 30, 2026, issuing $23M of 5.62% Senior Unsecured Notes due 2036 and $17M of 5.87% Senior Unsecured Notes due 2041 to institutional investors (State Farm Life Insurance Company, State Farm Life and Accident Assurance Company, CoBank, ACB). Proceeds will refinance existing debt or for general corporate purposes. The offering was exempt from registration under Section 4(a)(2) of the Securities Act. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation, with no acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring involved.
